subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: The tracker shall present the engine (through the WorkTracker port) and the human (through the CLI) with one store and one predicate implementation, never a separate machine store and human store.
rationale: divergent twin stores drift; single source of truth (AP-11)
fit_criterion: a CLI mutation is visible to the port immediately and vice versa; ready/triage predicates share one code path (inspection)
